simple.summary: בּוּר (bûwr) means to bore , i.e. (figuratively) examine First listed occurrence: Eccl 9 1.

definitions.full: H952. bur בּוּר verb Qal Infinitive construct לָבוּר Eccl 9:1 (with accusative); probably (si vera lectio) make clear, clear up, explain (VB; so sometimes, in Late Hebrew, ברר q. v.) but read perhaps ᵑ6 ᵐ5 רָאָה וְלִבִּי Bi; or לָתוּר Gr, compare 1:13 ; 2:13 ; 7:25 .
